Egypt advances in World Cup after penalty shootout win

Egypt has secured a place in the Round of 16 of the FIFA World Cup after defeating Australia in a penalty shootout. This victory marks a historic first knockout stage win for the Egyptian team. The match saw significant attention on player availability and team strategies.
